pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app metrics, health checks, and greenhouse

gist.headline: The greenhouse took attendance
gist.blurb: The bot made its daily walk through the app garden, refreshing health checks and metrics. The plants remain politely measurable.
gist.summary: Refreshed the daily app metrics, health-check records, and greenhouse status tables in apps/APPS.md and apps/GREENHOUSE.md.
gist.impact: Community maintainers get an up-to-date snapshot of listed apps and their greenhouse health without changing app functionality.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community app garden represented by neat rows of code-plants with tiny status tags, while Polli checks a clipboard beside a greenhouse dashboard. The scene conveys routine maintenance and a healthy open-source ecosystem rather than a product feature.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener visor, checking a clipboard beside a warm glass greenhouse full of code-plants and small health-check signs; a retro terminal glows prominent lime green (#ecf874) with simple pixel text "DAILY CHECK". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with flowers and vines around the app garden.
